TV Remote now has an **Android app**, built on the same Rust core as the desktop app and terminal UI.

## Android (new)

`tv-remote-0.2.0-android.apk` (Android 8.0+, arm64, armv7 and x86_64):

- **Remote**: D-pad, OK, Back, Home, Source, volume and channel rockers you can hold, mute, a volume slider, media keys, power, and a number pad with colour keys and Guide. Key presses vibrate.
- **Touchpad** for the TV's pointer, and **text input**: the text box opens by itself when the TV shows its keyboard.
- **Apps**: the TV's apps with YouTube and Netflix shortcuts; share a YouTube link from the phone to "Play on TV".
- **TVs**: find TVs on your Wi-Fi, pair (accept the prompt on the TV), add by IP, rename, several TVs.
- **Power**: off, and on with Wake-on-LAN.
- On Android 17 the app asks for the new **local network** permission, which it needs to find and reach the TV.

Casting from the phone and SmartThings are not in the Android app yet.

Install by opening the APK on the phone (allow installing apps from your browser or file manager), or with `adb install`. Later releases are signed with the same key and install over this one.

## Desktop and terminal UI

- **Fuller app list**: recent Tizen TVs ignore the app-list request, so the list comes from checking a catalogue of about 160 known app ids (it was 25, several wrong). On a 2025 Q7F the list went from 7 to 19 apps; the GUI, TUI and Android app all get it.
- TV discovery reports a network error instead of silently finding nothing.
- The core can use rustls instead of OpenSSL (`--features tvremote_core/rustls`); the desktop builds keep OpenSSL by default.

## Downloads

- `tv-remote-0.2.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`: `tv-remote` and `tv-remote-tui`, built on Arch Linux. Needs glibc 2.39+, GTK 4.22+ and libadwaita 1.8+ for the desktop app, and ffmpeg for casting. Building from source is recommended: see [Installation](https://github.com/awake-devel/tv-remote/blob/main/docs/installation.md).
- `tv-remote-0.2.0-android.apk`: the Android app.
- `SHA256SUMS`: check with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.
